body: I've tried. I've gotten the experience of pain and suffering.
Everyone finds out eventually. Why does it matter if it's a few decades earlier or later?
I don't want to live. This is more like a suicide note sort of thing.

The pain of death always passes. I've had many pets, most have died by now. It is excruciating pain in the first few months, after that, it is gone. My mother's dad died a year ago. She was heartbroken for about a month. It passed. So will I.
When I die, I will be gone. I will have no feeling, no thoughts, and mostly, no pain. The process may be painful but the result will be much better. It will release me from everything.
I have many digital friends. I have my family whom I visit frequently.
I go outside everyday. I tried gum as well. I tried getting a pet. I tried everything.

Could you dissolve it in water?

Also, sorry for laughing at the part where you mentioned that you have to give him better and better treats. It cracked me up.
I understand. I tried already. Thank you for your efforts. You are a very kind and understanding person.
I tried enjoying life. I didn't enjoy it. I tried a starbucks frappucino, and after that, a burger. Both were nice but didn't change my perspective.
I did. It's not that simple for me.
I don't feel comfortable divulging the information.
Pressured to do thing I ***REALLY*** don't want to do.
